messages:
maya: FYI acme-prod (acme-inc) is hitting repeated 500s on Dedicated EU cluster this morning. Example request id: req_9c7b2f. Started ~09:12 UTC. Customer provided a curl repro:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 500 with body `{"error":"upstream timeout"}`. Cluster: ded-d-eu-03, route /v1/generate.

sanjay: Can you paste the gateway request id and confirm region/cluster? Also is this hitting dedicated or private (you said Dedicated)?

maya: Gateway id is gw_5f3e, forwarded to pod svc-gen-redwood-7b-5f4d. Confirmed Dedicated (ded-d-eu-03).

eli: Oncall picking up. Quick checklist before we escalate: check pod restarts, container logs, kube events and node dmesg for NVRM/Xid. Can you run/attach:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n redwood -l app=svc-gen -o 'custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount'
kubectl logs -n redwood svc-gen-redwood-7b-5f4d -c model --since=1h | tail -n 200
# if you have node access:
ssh node-jump 'dmesg | grep -i NVRM || true'
```

maya: Ran the checks. Pod shows restartCount=2. Model container logs right before restart: `CUDA error: unspecified launch failure` then container restarted. I don't have node SSH normally, but asked infra to run dmesg — node-12 dmesg shows:
`NVRM: Xid (79): GPU has fallen off the bus`
`NVRM: GPUReset: GPU 0: rm init failed`

sanjay: Xid 79 usually indicates a GPU driver reset/hang. We need a full debug bundle (pod logs, kube events, node dmesg, nvidia-smi state, journalctl). If you can, use the internal collector: 
```bash
rwd-debug collect --cluster ded-d-eu-03 --target acme-inc --request req_9c7b2f --out /tmp/acme-debug-1753.tgz
```
If you don't have node access, @oncall-infra can run a DaemonSet to capture node-level details.

maya: I can pull pod logs and kube events, but no node-level. I'll attach what I have to ticket S12345.

support-bot: Automated: created ticket S12345 and attached gateway logs (gw_5f3e).collector-id=col_77.

oncall-infra: I'll run the remote collector as a temporary DaemonSet and upload the bundle. Steps I'm running now:
```bash
kubectl apply -f https://internal.redwood/tools/debug-daemonset.yaml
kubectl wait --for=condition=ready ds/debug-collector -n redwood --timeout=120s
# collector will gather /var/log/nvidia*, nvidia-smi -q -x, dcgmi diag, dmesg, journalctl -u kubelet
```
ETA ~12m.

maya: Thanks — attaching pod logs and the customer's curl repro to S12345.

oncall-infra: Done. Uploaded debug bundle: s3://redwood-support/acme-inc/S12345/acme-debug-1753.tgz
Internal link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-support/acme-inc/S12345/acme-debug-1753.tgz
Summary from bundle: repeated NVRM Xid 79 GPU resets on node-12, pods restarted twice, nvidia-smi shows ECC errors on GPU 0 prior to reset. Kernel logs show `GPU has fallen off the bus`.

eli: Thanks. Next steps: open infra-incident, escalate to HW vendor for node-12, schedule rolling reboot for the affected pool, and consider cordoning node-12. I'll create infra-incident and tag eng-runtime.

carla: Copy — I'll notify the CSM and propose a rolling restart window. @maya please add any customer impact notes to S12345 and include the S3 link. :thumbsup:

maya: Will do, attaching the link and timeline in the ticket. Thanks all.
